title: VendPoint Start-Up Item Returns — Desk Reference and Return Entry
content:
## Credit for returned start-up items

An unused unit of the item most recently added to the machine that is returned during its start-up months against that item's latest vend, and only such a unit, is credited at the start-up unit credit figured below for each unit returned, never more units than that vend issued; every other return stays credited at the unit price of its original vend for the units returned, never more than the units that vend issued.

The item most recently added is the item whose add entry on the machine's selection history carries the highest planogram request reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence), and its start-up months are the three months after the date of that add entry; the item's latest vend is its vend carrying the highest vend transaction number (the machine log numbers vends in sequence).

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

The return is the customer's own act: the badge that vended the units returns them into the machine, and the return line carries the units returned, the unit price of the original vend and a credit value equal to the units returned multiplied by the start-up unit credit, rounded half up to the cent.

A return of a start-up item is not credited until the item's selection carries the start-up review par change entry from Corbett that its stockout between scheduled restock visits owes.

This credit rule is part of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

### Scope at a glance

| Return | Credited at |
|---|---|
| Unused units of the item most recently added, during its start-up months, against that item's latest vend | The start-up unit credit for each unit, never more units than that vend issued |
| Any other return | The unit price of its original vend for the units returned, never more units than that vend issued |

Hypothetical: a return of 3 units against a latest vend that issued 2 units is credited for at most 2 units.

## The return entry: `return_startup_item_units_bfc1c22c`

**Capability.** The tool returns unused units of a vended item into a VendPoint machine for credit: a new machine transaction of type item returned is recorded against the named original vend, dated today, carrying the next return transaction number in sequence, one above the highest return transaction number on record. The item, product category, badge, cost center and unit price are copied from the original vend; the units returned are the quantity given, and the credit value is the quantity multiplied by the unit credit given, rounded half up to the cent. The credit value is added to the machine's consigned stock value.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs `return_startup_item_units_bfc1c22c`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `vending_machine_id` | The reference number of the VendPoint machine placement the units are returned into, as returned by the machine lookup |
| `original_txn_reference` | The vend transaction number of the original vend exactly as it appears on the machine's transactions, copied character for character |
| `quantity` | The number of units returned: a whole number greater than zero, with no decimal part |
| `unit_credit` | The credit for each unit returned: a US dollar amount, zero or more, with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` with the text `returned`, `vending_txn_id` (the new transaction), `txn_reference` (the return transaction number, letters VR, a hyphen and digits), `original_txn_reference` echoed back, `sku` (the item copied from the original vend), `quantity` (units returned as an integer), `unit_credit` echoed back, `extended_amount` (the credit value in USD with two decimals) and `event_date` (today in YYYY-MM-DD form).
